text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. Instead of just capturing pictures, it uses complex algorithms for image recognition, allowing systems to identify faces, objects, or even handwriting. A related task is object detection, where the computer not only names what it sees but also locates it within the frame by drawing boxes around items. These technologies have many practical applications, from unlocking your phone with your face to sorting photos in your gallery. Perhaps the most exciting use is in self-driving cars, where vision systems constantly analyze the road to detect pedestrians, traffic signs, and other vehicles, helping the car make safe decisions in real time.
